item.description:
[Episode 36] Hashtag Maneuver ([36화] 해시태그 공작)

☞ View from Episode 1 (☞ 1화부터 보기)

☞ Character Introductions (☞ 등장인물 소개)

Following the meeting between Alister and Chairman Cheon, the introduction of Sariel became an agenda item at the U.S.-Japan talks, and before long, the Japanese government decided to equip its new frigates with Sariel. (앨리스터와 천 공사의 만남 이후 사리엘 도입은 미·일 회담의 어젠다로 올랐고, 일본 정부는 얼마 지나지 않아 새 호위함에 사리엘을 장착하기로 했다.)

Just as Tachibana had calculated, the United States wanted Japan's shipyards, and the Japanese government desperately needed a cutting-edge defense system, so the Sariel introduction gained rapid momentum. (다치바나의 계산대로 미국은 일본의 조선소를 원했고, 일본 정부는 최첨단 방위 시스템이 간절했기에, 사리엘 도입은 급물살을 탔다.)

The debut venue for the Japanese version of Sariel was Dock No. 3 at the Nagasaki Shipyard. (일본판 사리엘의 데뷔 장소는 나가사키 조선소 제3도크였다.)

The commissioning ceremony for the Self-Defense Force ensign of the newest frigate, the "Zuya," which displayed its immense presence over the blue sea, was held. As the lively sound of trumpets scattered into the sea breeze, reporters from Japan's Ministry of Defense press corps moved in perfect unison behind the public affairs officer wearing the "MOD" armband. (푸른 바다 위로 거대한 위용을 드러낸 최신형 호위함 ‘스즈야’의 자위함기 수여식이 열렸다. 흥겨운 트럼펫 소리가 바닷바람에 흩어지는 사이, 일본 방위성 출입 기자들이 ‘MOD’ 완장을 찬 공보과 직원의 뒤로 일사불란하게 움직였다.)

"May the new frigate Zuya become a frigate that defends our nation..." (“새 호위함 스즈야가 우리나라를 수호하는 호위함이 되기를...”)

When the Defense Minister presented the triangularly folded Self-Defense Force ensign to the inaugural captain, Tachibana Shunsuke, president of Shirakawa Heavy Industries, could not hide his overwhelming emotion from the distant seating area. (방위성 대신이 삼각형으로 접힌 자위대 함기를 초대 함장에게 수여하자, 시라카와 중공업의 다치바나 슌스케 사장은 먼발치 객석에서 벅차오르는 표정을 감추지 못했다.)

"Sasage!" (“사사게!”)

With the Self-Defense Force member's booming command, the Rising Sun flag was hoisted up the stern flagpole. (자위대원의 우렁찬 구령과 함께 함미 깃대에 욱일기가 올랐다.)

Beyond the flag, the integrated mast, which would house Sariel's eyes, rose sleekly toward the sky. (깃발 너머, 사리엘의 눈이 들어설 통합 마스트가 하늘을 향해 매끈하게 솟아 있었다.)

"Look at that imposing figure. The moment Sariel's brain is implanted into that mast, the Japanese archipelago becomes an unsinkable aircraft carrier. From the northern Kuril Islands, it will monitor Russian fighter jets; from Yonaguni in the west, China's carrier battle groups; and in the East Sea, North Korean missiles—all in real time." (“보십시오. 저 늠름한 자태를. 저 마스트에 사리엘의 뇌가 이식되는 순간, 일본 열도는 불침(不沈) 항모가 됩니다. 북쪽 쿠릴열도에선 러시아의 전투기를, 서쪽 요나구니에선 중국의 항모 전단을, 동해에선 북한의 미사일을 실시간으로 감시하게 될 겁니다.”)

The Maritime Chief of Staff beside him lowered his voice. (곁의 해상막료장이 목소리를 낮췄다.)

"This is purely hypothetical, but—if there were a contingency in Taiwan, could it neutralize the Chinese military's anti-access strategy? Is that how we should understand it?" (“어디까지나 가정입니다만. 대만 유사시, 중국군의 반접근 전략을 무력화할 수 있다, 그렇게 이해해도 되겠습니까?”)

"It's not neutralization. It's clarification." (“무력화가 아닙니다. 선명화입니다.”)

Tachibana spread his palm open. (다치바나가 손바닥을 펴 보였다.)

"All the data on how the enemy moves comes right into the palm of this hand." (“적들이 움직이는 모든 데이터가 이 손바닥 안으로 들어오는 겁니다.”)

Minister Nakamura, standing beside Tachibana, folded the pamphlet in half instead of applauding. (다치바나 곁에 있던 나카무라 장관은 박수 대신 팸플릿을 반으로 접었다.)

"President Tachibana. Keep the expression 'unsinkable aircraft carrier' out of the presence of reporters. It will come back to haunt us at tomorrow morning's Diet session. This is a nation where the four characters for 'exclusively defense-oriented' are still very much alive." (“다치바나 사장. ‘불침 항모’라는 표현, 기자들 앞에서는 넣어두시죠. 내일 아침 국회 질의로 돌아옵니다. 전수방위 네 글자가 아직 살아 있는 나라입니다.”)

"I merely chose an expression to celebrate a day like today." (“어디까지나 오늘 같은 날을 축하하기 위한 표현을 골라봤습니다.”)

"I'll do my celebrating after I stamp the final approval on the paperwork." (“축하는 결재 서류에 마지막 도장을 찍은 뒤에 하겠습니다.”)

Minister Nakamura looked up at the frigate's hull instead of replying. The bureaucrat's unease—that things could not possibly go this smoothly—crossed his mind. (나카무라 장관은 대답 대신 호위함의 선체를 올려다봤다. 모든 게 너무 순탄하게 흘러갈 리 없다는 관료의 불길함이 그의 뇌리를 스쳤다.)

Before the celebratory toast in Nagasaki had even dried, the front lines of Northeast Asia began to blaze across smartphone screens. (나가사키의 축배가 마르기도 전에, 동북아시아의 전선은 스마트폰 화면에서 불타오르기 시작했다.)

[News] Self-Defense Force Secrets Leaking to Korean Company? Korean Taesan Defense Involved in Sariel's Core Technology ([기사] 자위대 기밀, 한국 기업에 넘어간다? 사리엘 핵심 기술은 한국 태산디펜스가 관여)

[Commentary] Why Should Taxpayer Money Line Koreans' Pockets? Japan's Security at Risk of Becoming Dependent on Korean AI! ([논평] 왜 혈세가 한국인들의 배를 불리는가? 일본의 안보가 한국 AI에 종속될 위기!)

Provocative articles originating from China spread like an oil slick across X, Instagram, and blogs. Posts that maliciously stitched together articles about the Duda-iel and Taesan Defense partnership. A glance at the sentence patterns and posting times made it obvious to any professional eye that these were crude fabrications. (중국발 선동 기사들이 X, 인스타그램, 블로그를 타고 기름띠처럼 번졌다. 듀다엘과 태산디펜스의 파트너십 기사를 악의적으로 짜깁기한 게시물들. 문장 패턴과 게시 시간대를 조금만 들여다보면, 프로의 눈에는 영락없는 조잡한 가공물이었다.)

Even so, online public opinion exploded in an instant—or rather, appeared to explode. (그럼에도 인터넷 여론은 삽시간에 불타올랐다, 아니 불타오르는 것처럼 보였다.)

The epicenter was estimated to be thousands of bot accounts routed through a third country, not Tokyo or Osaka. The enraged public couldn't tell the difference. Or rather, they didn't bother trying. If they couldn't stop the hardware from being introduced, the clear intent was to disrupt the software that operates it—public sentiment—and block further Sariel deployments. That was evident to Evan's eyes. (진원지는 도쿄도 오사카도 아닌 제3국을 경유한 봇 계정 수천 개로 추정됐다. 분노한 대중은 그것을 구분하지 못했다. 아니, 굳이 구분하려 들지 않았다. 하드웨어 도입을 막을 수 없다면, 그 하드웨어를 운용하는 소프트웨어인 민심을 어지럽혀 사리엘의 추가 도입을 막겠다는 의지가 선명히 읽혔다, 에반의 눈에는.)

The Japanese government probably never imagined that introducing an AI border system like Sariel would ignite public fury. (일본 정부는 사리엘 같은 AI 경계 시스템 도입이 대중의 분노로 이어질 것이라고 보지 않았을 것이다.)

A side note: years ago, when the Japanese government imposed export controls on semiconductor and display core materials against the Korean government as a form of protest—the so-called "whitelist" exclusion—it reportedly never anticipated that it would spiral into an extreme anti-Japan campaign like "No Japan." A move that elite bureaucrats thought of as a chess game between officials—one that, in reality, didn't even achieve much effect—came back as a boomerang in the form of plunging sales of their own beer and cars. A peculiar situation. (잡설이지만, 수년 전 일본 정부가 한국 정부에 항의 목적으로 반도체·디스플레이 핵심 소재 수출 통제, 이른바 ‘화이트리스트’ 배제 조치를 내놓았을 때, 그것이 ‘노 재팬’이라는 극단적인 반일 캠페인으로 이어질 것이라곤 예상치 못했다고 한다. 엘리트 관료끼리의 체스 게임이라고 생각했던 한 수가, 그것도 실제로는 그렇게 효과를 거두진 못했던 한 수가, 자국 맥주와 자동차 매출 급감이라는 부메랑으로 돌아왔던 기묘한 상황.)

Those who stir the pot always exploit such gaps. (선동하는 자들은 늘 그런 빈틈을 파고든다.)

But unlike back then, this time the arrow was pointing in the exact opposite direction. (다만 그때와 달리, 이번엔 그 화살의 방향이 정반대였다.)

China wasn't simply spreading fake news. Using AI, a flood of memes and comments poured out in an instant, subtly stoking anti-Korean sentiment in an attempt to drive a wedge between allies. (중국은 단순히 가짜 뉴스를 퍼뜨리는 것이 아니었다. AI를 활용한 각종 밈과 댓글이 단숨에 쏟아져 나오며 혐한 정서를 교묘하게 자극해 이간질을 시도했다.)

The seeds sown by the bot accounts quickly took root, nourished by the anger of Japan's anti-Korean net-right wing. The architects knew better than anyone, from their own modern history, that while crowds struggle to create something new, their ability to destroy is unparalleled. (봇 계정들이 뿌린 씨앗은 일본 혐한 넷 우익의 분노를 자양분 삼아 빠르게 발아했다. 군중이 무언가를 새로 만들기는 어려워도 무언가를 파괴하는 능력만큼은 탁월하다는 사실을, 설계자들은 자신들의 현대사를 통해 누구보다 잘 알고 있었다.)

On internet forums, conspiracy theories began to bloom organically. (인터넷 게시판에서는 음모론이 자생적으로 피어오르기 시작했다.)

Theories such as "Korea holds Sariel's kill switch" and "Taesan Defense is secretly backdooring Self-Defense Force radar data to the South Korean military" spread virally without any verification. (‘사리엘의 킬 스위치를 한국이 쥐고 있다’는 설, ‘태산디펜스가 자위대 레이더 데이터를 한국군에 백도어로 넘기고 있다’는 설 등 각종 음모론이 검증 없이 확산됐다.)

Each deepfake video post drew hundreds of approving comments within minutes. (딥페이크 영상 게시물 하나당 수백 개의 동조 댓글이 몇 분 만에 달렸다.)

On social media, #サリエル反対, #チョン諜, and #NoKorea climbed to the top trends. Not knowing Japanese didn't matter. An image of the Korean flag with a red prohibition mark overlaid was enough to make it clear where the anger was directed. In a state where fake and real were indistinguishable, the hashtags took on a life of their own. (소셜미디어에서는 #サリエル反対, #チョン諜, #NoKorea가 상위 트렌드에 올랐다. 일본어를 몰라도 상관없었다. 태극기에 빨간 금지 표시를 덧댄 이미지 하나만으로, 분노가 누구를 향하는지는 분명했다. 가짜와 진짜가 구분되지 않는 상태에서, 해시태그는 자체 생명력을 얻었다.)

While Alister sipped tea elegantly and Tachibana burned with ambition, the cable Chairman Cheon had transmitted to Beijing came back in the form of this kind of warfare, beginning to shake Evan's life. (앨리스터가 우아하게 차를 마시고, 다치바나가 야망을 불태우는 사이, 천 공사가 베이징으로 타전한 전문은 이런 형태의 전쟁으로 되돌아와 에반의 삶을 흔들기 시작했다.)

And Michelle, in Manila, watched the chaos with the amused expression of someone spectating a sporting event. To her, lofty phrases like Korea-U.S.-Japan security cooperation were nothing but noise. (그리고 미셸은 마닐라에서 이 혼란을 스포츠 경기마냥 흥미롭다는 표정으로 지켜봤다. 그녀에게 한·미·일 안보 협력 같은 고상한 단어는 노이즈에 불과했다.)

There was only one target. (표적은 오직 하나뿐이었다.)

item.title: Politicization of the military, self-preservation, kowtowing to the North... How they created a third-rate army (軍 정치화, 보신주의, 北 눈치… 삼류 군대 만들었다)
item.description:
Politicization of the military, self-preservation, kowtowing to the North... How they created a third-rate army (軍 정치화, 보신주의, 北 눈치… 삼류 군대 만들었다)

Recently, the reality of a military with crumbling discipline has been exposed in various places. It was confirmed that front-line units stood guard with unloaded rifles, with magazines removed. An absurd incident also occurred where, during a front-line drone operation, a friendly aircraft was nearly shot down due to a lack of information sharing. In the Marine Corps, weapons and live ammunition were taken off base, yet they failed to even grasp the situation for a long time. (최근 군기 빠진 군의 실태가 곳곳에서 드러나고 있습니다. 최전방 부대에선 탄창을 뺀 채 빈총으로 경계 근무를 선 사실이 확인됐습니다. 전방 무인기 작전 중 정보 소통 부재로 아군기를 격추할 뻔하는 어이없는 일도 벌어졌습니다. 해병대에선 총기와 실탄이 외부로 반출됐는데도 장시간 상황 파악조차 못 했습니다.)

During the Moon Jae-in administration as well, the military's front-line fence lines, naval bases, and the capital defense command were breached time and again. Out of deference to North Korea, not only ROK-U.S. exercises but even their own military training was frequently postponed, scaled down, or canceled. As a result, the military was criticized as "an army that doesn't train" and "an army that defends the country through dialogue with the enemy rather than through strength." (문재인 정부 때도 군은 전방 철책선과 해군기지, 수방사 등이 번번이 뚫렸습니다. 북한 눈치를 보느라 한미 훈련은 물론이고 자체 군사 훈련도 수시로 연기·축소·취소됐습니다. 그래서 ‘훈련하지 않는 군대’ ‘힘이 아니라 적과의 대화로 나라를 지키는 군대’라는 비판을 받았습니다.)

But now, concerns are being raised that under the Lee Jae-myung administration, which champions "pragmatism and security," the situation is getting worse rather than better. As the government pushes a policy of rapprochement with North Korea, ROK-U.S. exercises are being frequently scaled down and postponed. Despite North Korea's hostile policies, the military changed the Military Demarcation Line in a way favorable to the North. The military also belatedly announced North Korea's missile provocations. (그런데 ‘실용과 안보’를 앞세운 이재명 정부에서 상황이 나아지기는커녕 더 나빠지고 있다는 우려가 나옵니다. 정부가 대북 화해 정책을 앞세우면서 한미 훈련은 수시로 축소·연기되고 있습니다. 북한의 적대시 정책에도 불구하고 군은 우리 군사분계선을 북한에 유리하게 바꿨습니다. 북의 미사일 도발도 늑장 발표했습니다.)

Dissonance between South Korea and the U.S. is also growing over the transition of wartime operational control (OPCON). Conflicts have repeatedly flared up over the UN Command's DMZ management authority. There was even a public clash between ROK and U.S. military leaders over U.S. exercises in the West Sea. Nuclear negotiations with the U.S. and discussions on introducing nuclear-powered submarines are stagnating. Assessments are emerging that communication and cooperation between South Korea and the U.S. are increasingly weakening. (전시작전통제권 전환을 놓고 한미 간 불협화음도 커지고 있습니다. 유엔사의 DMZ 관리권을 놓고 걸핏하면 갈등이 불거졌습니다. 미군의 서해 훈련을 두고는 한미 군 수뇌부가 공개 충돌하기도 했습니다. 미국과의 원자력 협상과 원잠 도입 논의는 지지부진합니다. 한·미 간 소통과 협력이 갈수록 약화되고 있다는 평가가 나옵니다.)

With the government pushing a policy of appeasement toward North Korea, and with successive disciplinary actions against general officers and senior officials following the martial law incident, concerns are growing that the military is becoming increasingly politicized. Observers say the military appears fixated on aligning with the administration's agenda while kowtowing to North Korea. There is a strong impression that commanders, rather than enhancing operational capabilities and strengthening vigilance, are adopting a self-preserving, blame-avoiding mindset of "let's just avoid any incidents during our tenure." Concerns are mounting that the military, far from being reborn as an elite, technologically advanced strong force, is devolving into a third-rate army. (정부가 대북 유화 정책을 앞세우고, 계엄 사태에 따른 군 장성과 간부급 징계도 잇따르면서 군이 점점 정치화하는 것 아니냐는 우려가 커지고 있습니다. 정권과 코드를 맞추면서 북한 눈치 보기에 급급한 모습을 보인다는 것입니다. 군 지휘관들은 작전 능력을 높이고 경계를 강화하기보다는 ‘재임 중 사고만 피하자’는 식의 보신주의와 면피주의로 가고 있다는 인상이 짙습니다. 정예화·과학화된 강군(强軍)으로 거듭나기는커녕 삼류 군대로 전락하고 있다는 우려가 커지는 상황입니다.)

An unprecedented incident occurred on the 3rd when the commander of the 1st Corps, Han Ki-sung, a core force guarding the capital Seoul on the front lines, was removed from duty. Lieutenant General Han issued instructions to stand guard with unloaded weapons, removing magazines from K6 heavy machine guns and K4 rapid-fire grenade launchers. And that's not all. The 1st Corps also reportedly stood guard with empty K2 rifles, with ammunition removed. The Joint Chiefs of Staff initially denied this but later confirmed it to be true. (최전방에서 수도 서울을 지키는 핵심 전력인 1군단의 한기성 군단장이 지난 3일 직무 배제되는 이례적 사태가 벌어졌습니다. 한기성 1군단장은 K6 중기관총과 K4 고속유탄발사기 등에서 탄창을 빼고 빈총으로 경계 근무를 서라는 지침을 내렸습니다. 이뿐이 아닙니다. 1군단은 개인화기인 K2 소총에서도 총알을 뺀 채 빈총으로 경계를 섰다고 합니다. 합참은 애초 이를 부인했지만 뒤늦게 사실로 확인됐습니다.)

Why was such an absurd order given? reportedly, during his time as a division commander, an accidental discharge occurred toward North Korea during a weapons inspection. If the North had protested or higher-ups launched an investigation, it could have created a difficult situation. So, to avoid such an occurrence, the 1st Corps ordered guards to stand watch with magazines removed. In other words, they removed the bullets out of fear that bullets might fly toward the enemy. This not only makes rapid response difficult in emergencies but also endangers the lives of our soldiers. Yet the commander effectively disarmed the troops to avoid a headache-inducing situation. (왜 이런 어이없는 지시가 내려갔던 것일까요. 한 군단장은 사단장 시절 총기 점검 중 북으로 총이 오발되는 사고가 있었다고 합니다. 북한이 이에 항의하거나 상부에서 경위 조사에 나서면 곤란한 상황이 일어날 수 있었던 겁니다. 그래서 1군단에선 이런 일이 일어나는 걸 피하려고 탄창을 빼고 경계 근무를 서게 했다는 것입니다. 적에게 총알이 날아갈까 봐 총알을 뺐다는 얘기가 됩니다. 유사시 신속한 대응이 힘든 것은 물론이고 우리 병사의 목숨이 위태로울 수 있는 일입니다. 그런데 지휘관이 골치 아픈 상황을 피하려고 병사들을 무장해제시킨 꼴입니다.)

Lieutenant General Han was reportedly the first 1st Corps commander from the ROTC background and was a strong candidate for promotion to four-star general. He had even directly briefed President Lee Jae-myung on front-line警戒 situations. But fearing a mishap from an accidental discharge toward the North, he simply removed the ammunition entirely. There's a saying: "What matters most?" This is an act of forgetting the military's fundamental mission. Some are even saying, "This isn't just a 1st Corps problem." The Joint Chiefs of Staff didn't even know about this situation. (한 군단장은 첫 학군 출신 1군단장으로 대장 진급이 유력했다고 합니다. 이재명 대통령에게 직접 전방 지역 경계 상황을 브리핑하기도 했습니다. 그런데 대북 오발 사고가 나면 낭패를 볼 수 있으니 아예 총알을 빼버린 겁니다. ‘뭣이 중헌디’라는 말이 있죠. 군의 기본 임무를 망각한 행태입니다. “1군단만의 일도 아니다”라는 얘기까지 나옵니다. 합참은 이런 실태조차 파악하지 못하고 있었습니다.)

Following the misidentification controversy involving a U.S. drone, a similar incident occurred in the 1st Corps with our own drone. A captain in charge of operational intelligence failed to report U.S. drone operation information provided by the U.S. military to higher-ups, leading to the U.S. drone being mistaken for a North Korean drone. The military even launched an actual intercept operation. However, tracking failed, and no shootdown was attempted. (미군 무인기에 이어 우리 무인기 오인 식별 논란도 1군단에서 벌어졌습니다. 작전 정보를 담당하는 대위가 미군이 통보한 무인기 작전 정보를 상부에 보고하지 않아서 미군 무인기를 북 무인기로 오인했던 것입니다. 군은 실제 격추 작전에도 나섰습니다. 하지만 추적에 실패해 격추 시도는 하지 못했습니다.)

During the 1st Corps' own drone operation, the drone's altitude rose higher than planned, reportedly causing it to be mistaken for an unidentified drone. They couldn't even distinguish friend from foe. While individual fault may exist, there are also criticisms that problems lie in the ROK-U.S. communication and operational systems. (1군단 자체 무인기 작전 과정에서도 무인기 고도가 예정보다 높아지는 바람에 신원 미상 무인기로 오인하는 상황이 벌어졌다고 합니다. 피아 구분도 못한 것입니다. 개인의 잘못도 있겠지만 한미 간 소통이나 작전 체계에 문제가 있다는 지적이 나옵니다.)

In the Marine Corps, an incident involving the leakage of weapons and live ammunition occurred. On the 3rd, a Marine Corps officer was found dead from a gunshot wound at off-base housing in Pohang, North Gyeongsang Province. He appears to have taken a K1 submachine gun and live ammunition from the unit. However, the Marine Corps reportedly did not know about the weapon leakage for over 60 hours. Weapons management in the military is supposed to be among the strictest, yet a hole was punched here too. (해병대에선 총기·실탄 유출 사고가 벌어졌습니다. 지난 3일 경북 포항의 해병대 간부가 영외 숙소에서 총기로 숨진 채 발견됐는데요. 부대에서 K1 기관단총과 실탄을 가지고 나간 것으로 보입니다. 그런데 해병대는 총기 유출 사실을 60시간 넘게 몰랐다고 합니다. 군에서 총기 관리는 무엇보다 엄격한데 여기도 구멍이 뚫린 겁니다.)

President Lee Jae-myung said during a Ministry of National Defense briefing on the 5th, "Korea Military Academy (KMA) graduates staged coups three times, and responsibility was never held." He also said, "KMA graduates could stage another coup." This is interpreted as explaining the background for integrating the army, navy, and air force academies. (이재명 대통령은 5일 국방부 업무 보고에서 “육사 출신이 세 번이나 쿠데타를 했는데 한 번도 책임을 묻지 않았다”고 했습니다. 또 “육사 출신이 또 쿠데타를 할 수도 있다”고 했습니다. 육사·해사·공사 등 사관학교를 통합하는 배경을 설명한 것으로 해석됩니다.)

Despite strong opposition from various quarters, the military has pushed ahead with the integration of the army, navy, and air force academies. Criticisms included "Even the U.S., UK, and France don't do that" and "Isn't this just purging a KMA that's fallen out of favor?" Then President Lee pointed to the KMA's involvement in coups as the biggest reason for the integration. But the coups directly staged by KMA graduates occurred during the Park Chung-hee and Chun Doo-hwan governments. The martial law incident during the Yoon Suk-yeol government was different in nature from a coup. Questions are being raised about whether it's appropriate to hold the KMA responsible for a coup from 46 years ago and integrate the academies to prevent recurrence. (군은 그동안 각계의 거센 반대에도 육·해·공 사관학교 통합을 밀어붙였습니다. “미국·영국·프랑스도 그렇게 안 한다” “미운털 박힌 육사 처내기 아니냐”는 지적이 나왔습니다. 그런데 이 대통령이 사관학교 통합의 가장 큰 이유로 육사의 쿠데타 참여를 지적한 것입니다. 하지만 육사 출신이 직접 쿠데타를 일으킨 것은 박정희·전두환 정부 때였습니다. 윤석열 정부 때 계엄 사태는 쿠데타와는 성격이 다릅니다. 46년 전의 쿠데타를 두고 육사에 책임을 묻고 재발 방지를 위해 사관학교를 통합하는 것이 맞느냐는 의문이 제기됩니다.)

The controversy over the defense minister's desertion also shows no signs of dying down. Minister Ahn Kyu-baek has failed to clearly explain the allegations that he deserted during his compulsory service. He could simply disclose his military service records and undergo a correction process, but he's doing neither. This has led to criticisms such as "Isn't the desertion real?" "The minister has no authority," and "Can military reform really succeed?" (국방장관 탈영 논란도 사그라들지 않고 있습니다. 안규백 장관은 방위 복무 시절 탈영했다는 의혹에 대해 속 시원하게 해명을 못 하고 있습니다. 병적기록부를 공개하고 오류 정정 절차를 밟으면 되는데, 둘 다 하지 않고 있습니다. 이 때문에 “탈영이 사실 아니냐” “장관의 영이 안 선다” “군 개혁이 제대로 되겠느냐”는 지적이 나옵니다.)

Criticisms are also being raised that cracks have appeared in the military's vigilance posture against North Korea and the ROK-U.S. alliance system. During the Moon Jae-in administration, front-line fences were repeatedly breached by North Korean defectors and North Korean escapees, to the point that the term "knock defection" emerged. Naval bases and the capital defense command were also frequently infiltrated by drunks, the elderly, and protesters. ROK-U.S. joint exercises were also frequently postponed and scaled down out of deference to North Korea. Eventually, they were often replaced with computer simulation exercises. (군의 대북 경계 태세와 한미 연합 체제에도 균열이 생겼다는 지적이 나옵니다. 문재인 정부 땐 노크 귀순이라는 말이 나올 정도로 전방 책이 북 귀순자와 월북자 등에게 번번이 뚫렸습니다. 해군 기지와 수방사에도 취객·노인·시위대 등이 무단 침입하곤 했습니다. 한미 연합 훈련도 북한 눈치를 보느라 수시로 연기·축소됐습니다. 나중엔 아예 컴퓨터 시뮬레이션 연습으로 바뀌곤 했습니다.)

Under this administration, things are going a step further. The Joint Chiefs of Staff changed the Military Demarcation Line criteria in a way favorable to the North. When the North fired ballistic missiles around the June 25 anniversary (of the Korean War), the military only belatedly announced it, and only after the North itself had disclosed the fact. (그런데 이 정부 들어 한술 더 뜨는 상황이 되고 있습니다. 합참은 군사분계선 기준을 북측에 유리하게 바꿨습니다. 북이 6·25에 맞춰 탄도미사일을 쐈는데, 군은 북이 이 사실을 발표한 후에야 비로소 늑장 공개했습니다.)

A "martial law phobia" is now widespread throughout the military. If even the slightest suspicion of involvement in the martial law incident is raised, generals are being investigated, disciplined, or forced out in droves. While pushing to reclaim wartime OPCON unconditionally, the ROK-U.S. exercises needed for that purpose have been repeatedly scaled down and postponed. South Korea and the U.S. have clashed over the UN Command's DMZ management authority. ROK and U.S. military leaders publicly clashed over U.S. exercises in the West Sea. Following Minister Chung Dong-young's remarks about North Korea's uranium enrichment facilities, intelligence sharing with the U.S. was also halted. People are asking, "Has the cooperation framework between the ROK and U.S. militaries ever been this weakened?" (지금 군에는 ‘계엄 포비아’가 광범위하게 번져 있습니다. 계엄 연루 의혹이 조금이라도 제기되면 장성들이 줄줄이 수사·징계를 당하거나 옷을 벗었기 때문입니다. 전작권 회수를 강행하면서도 그에 필요한 한미 훈련은 잇따라 축소·연기했습니다. 유엔사의 DMZ 관리권 문제로 한미가 갈등을 빚었고요. 미군 서해 훈련을 놓고는 한미 군 수뇌부가 공개 충돌했습니다. 정동영 장관의 북한 우라늄 농축 시설 발언 이후 미국과 대북 정보 공유도 중단됐습니다. “한·미 양국 군 사이의 협력 체제가 이처럼 약화된 적이 있었느냐”는 말이 나옵니다.)

Because of this, the saying "even the Tang dynasty army would have no excuse" is circulating within military circles. The root cause can be found in the politicization of the military and self-preservationism. (이 때문에 군 주변에선 “당나라 군대라고 해도 할 말이 없다”는 얘기가 나옵니다. 그 근본 원인은 군의 정치화와 보신주의에서 찾을 수 있습니다.)

The core of a strong army lies in overwhelming operational capability, readiness against the enemy, and an indomitable will to fight and win. Among these, readiness against the enemy—that is, vigilance posture—is of paramount importance. There's a saying that operational failures may be forgiven, but failures in vigilance cannot be. (강군의 핵심은 압도적 작전 능력과 적에 대한 대비 태세, 싸워 이긴다는 불굴의 정신력입니다. 그중에서도 적에 대한 대비 태세, 즉 경계 태세는 무엇보다 중요합니다. 작전 실패는 용서해도 경계 실패는 용서할 수 없다는 말이 있을 정도입니다.)

Yet among our military leadership, a self-preserving, blame-avoiding culture has spread widely, where avoiding accidents or scandals is considered more important than performing well in operations or standing watch properly. The reasoning is that no matter how capable an officer or senior NCO is, they cannot survive once they become the subject of gossip or are involved in an incident. (그런데 우리 군 지휘부 사이에선 작전 잘하고 경계 잘 서는 것보다 사고나 구설을 피하는 게 가장 중요하다는 보신주의·면피주의가 광범위하게 번져 있습니다. 구설수에 오르거나 사고가 나면 아무리 유능한 장교와 간부도 버틸 수 없다는 이유입니다.)

The perception is also pervasive that one must align well with the administration's agenda to be promoted. The military can only properly fulfill its mission if it stays out of politics, but the politicization of the military is tending to grow worse. Kowtowing to North Korea is also a serious problem. Aligning with the government's appeasement policy toward the North has led to a widespread belief throughout the military that even minor clashes with North Korea must be avoided. (정권과 코드를 잘 맞춰야 승진할 수 있다는 인식도 팽배합니다. 군이 정치에서 벗어나야 본연의 임무를 제대로 수행할 수 있는데 군의 정치화가 갈수록 더 심해지는 경향입니다. 북한 눈치 보기도 심각합니다. 정부의 대북 유화 정책에 맞추다 보니 북한과 작은 충돌도 피해야 한다는 생각이 군 전체에 퍼져 있습니다.)

The unconditional push for OPCON transition is also adversely affecting ROK-U.S. security cooperation. The U.S. supports OPCON transition in principle but insists that the ROK military's capability to assume wartime operational control must first be verified. The government, however, insists on unconditionally taking back wartime OPCON as early as next year, or at least within its term. Yet it remains passive about the ROK-U.S. exercises that would enhance and verify operational command capabilities. Problems are erupting everywhere, but the presidential office says "there are no issues." Observers point out that with no sense of crisis and no leadership authority, it's inevitable that the military's discipline erodes and it becomes a weakened force. (무조건적인 전작권 전환 정책도 한미 안보 협력에 악영향을 주고 있습니다. 미국은 전작권 전환 자체는 찬성하지만 한국군이 전시 작전권을 넘겨받을 능력이 먼저 검증돼야 한다고 얘기합니다. 그런데 정부는 이르면 내년, 적어도 임기 중에 전작권을 무조건 넘겨받아야 한다고 주장합니다. 그러면서도 작전 지휘 능력을 높이고 이를 검증할 수 있는 한미 훈련에는 소극적입니다. 곳곳에서 문제가 터지는데 청와대는 “별문제가 없다”고 합니다. 위기감도 없고 영도 안 서니 군기 빠진 군대가 될 수밖에 없다는 지적이 나옵니다.)

item.title: "Even after spending 10 trillion won to build the Pyeongtaek base, U.S. delays returning donated land with pretext-like reasons" (“美軍, 평택 기지 10조 들여 지어줘도 핑계 같은 이유로 공여지 반환 늦어”)
item.description:
"Even after spending 10 trillion won to build the Pyeongtaek base, U.S. delays returning donated land with pretext-like reasons" (“美軍, 평택 기지 10조 들여 지어줘도 핑계 같은 이유로 공여지 반환 늦어”)

President Lee Jae-myung said on the 5th, "After staging a military coup and cutting the country in half, they took no responsibility—how can such a thing be allowed?" and stated that the integration of the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies is intended to prevent military coups. The Ministry of National Defense had previously cited "strengthening joint operations" and "efficient use of educational resources" as reasons for integrating the military academies, but the President himself revealed that it is effectively aimed at neutralizing the Army Academy. Recent polls show that more than half of the public opposes the integration of the academies, and alumni associations of each military academy have voiced unanimous opposition. Nevertheless, the President reaffirmed his determination to push ahead, saying, "If we integrate, the likelihood of (a coup) decreases." <<> At a foreign affairs and security ministries' work report held at Cheong Wa Dae the same day, President Lee said regarding the return of U.S. military bases, "The negotiations on the return of donated land seem to be dragging on," calling it "something that defies common sense." He then instructed the Ministry of National Defense and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to cooperate and "step up the pace" on the return of U.S.-donated land in the Seoul metropolitan area. <<> Under the Roh Moo-hyun administration, South Korea and the U.S. agreed to relocate the Yongsan U.S. military base in Seoul to Pyeongtaek, Gyeonggi Province, and also to redeploy U.S. bases in northern Gyeonggi. Accordingly, the U.S. Forces Korea command officially moved to Camp Humphreys in Pyeongtaek in 2018, but some of the donated land slated for return remains unusable by our side due to disagreements between the two countries over the burden of environmental cleanup costs and inadequate replacement facilities. <<> In response, President Lee said that day, "Even though we built the Pyeongtaek base completely and they moved in, there are many places they haven't vacated, and some they have vacated but the follow-up procedures aren't done, so we're effectively unable to use them." When Minister of National Defense Ahn Kyu-baek noted that "the U.S. side has taken a somewhat passive stance," President Lee remarked, "This is why you shouldn't pay in advance in the first place." He added, "Building the Pyeongtaek base cost 10 trillion won. In my view, it's close to an excuse—they don't hand it over for various reasons, and if they keep attaching conditions one by one and preventing us from using it, isn't that a problem?" <<> President Lee stated, "Self-reliant defense is our greatest task," and reiterated his existing position that wartime operational control (OPCON) should be transferred during his term. He said, "It is unthinkable for our military not to follow the orders of the Minister of National Defense, who receives commands from the President as the commander-in-chief," adding, "Naturally, military command authority, which is part of sovereignty, must be exercised by ourselves." <<> Regarding policy toward North Korea, President Lee said, "Even if it's difficult, we must continue the policy of peace and coexistence (toward the North)." He noted, "(Because the North isn't responding,) the Ministry of Unification must feel like it's shouting into the void. It will be a bit tough," but warned, "If we take the attitude of 'I go my way, you go yours,' it will ultimately harm the national community." <<> However, President Lee took a cautious stance on some arguments that North Korea should be called the "Democratic People's Republic of Korea" as the regime desires. Minister of Unification Jeong Dong-young said that day, "We must stop the language of confrontation and hatred, such as 'main enemy,'" adding, "Respecting the other side by calling their name will build trust and be the first step toward peace and coexistence." The intent was to replace the designation of North Korea as the "main enemy" with "threat" and to bring the use of the term "Joseon" into public discourse. (이재명 대통령은 5일 “군사 쿠데타를 일으켜서 나라를 절단을 내고 난 다음에도 아무런 책임을 안 지고 이런 경우가 어디 있느냐”며 육·해·공군 사관학교 통합이 군사 쿠데타를 막기 위한 취지라고 말했다. 국방부는 그간 군 사관학교 통합 이유로 ‘합동성 강화’ ‘교육자원 효율화’ 등을 들었는데, 사실상 육사를 무력화하려는 취지라고 대통령이 스스로 밝힌 것이다. 사관학교 통합은 최근 여론조사에서 국민 절반 이상이 반대하고, 각군 사관학교 동창회도 일제히 반발했다. 그런데도 대통령은 “통합을 하면 (쿠데타를 할) 이럴 가능성이 줄어든다”며 강행 방침을 밝혔다.)

But President Lee said, "Because unintentionally, a single term or expression becomes the subject of political strife, I feel we need to be even more cautious." He also said, "There are times when I wonder whether what we do in good faith is truly a 'plus' for peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula," adding, "We really need to think this through carefully." <<> President Lee, who returned home after an 11-day tour of the U.S., South America, and Germany, said, "When you sincerely and wholeheartedly hold summits with specific countries, things change a lot for the better," adding, "The Ministry of Foreign Affairs should endure even if it's hard, since it's the early part of the term—things will ease up in the latter half." Regarding the South American tour, he said, "They think, 'Korea came at the start of the term? They must value us,'" adding, "Doing it early in the term seems to create greater opportunities to strengthen relations with those countries and companies." He also said, "Overseas nationals with voting rights number as many as 2 million—a huge figure," and instructed active consideration of institutional improvements such as introducing postal voting to enhance voting conditions for overseas nationals. <<> Meanwhile, Minister of Foreign Affairs Cho Hyun said at a post-event briefing that day that "high-level negotiations (with the U.S.) will take place soon" regarding securing Korea's right to enrich uranium. Minister Cho said, "Various situations, including the Middle East war, have delayed high-level talks," adding, "I don't see U.S. investment as an obstacle, but U.S. investment is something that needs to proceed quickly on its own." Regarding his first meeting the previous day with new U.S. Ambassador to Korea Michelle Steel, Minister Cho said, "We discussed several points on the basic direction of the Korea-U.S. relationship." On disagreements between the two countries, including the Coupang issue, he said, "We are working to resolve such matters as quickly as possible." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 열린 외교·안보 부처 업무보고에서 미군 기지 반환과 관련해선 “공여지 반환 협상이 늦어지는 것 같다”며 “상식적으로 말이 안 되는 일”이라고 했다. 그러면서 국방부와 외교부가 협력해 수도권 일대 미군 공여지 반환에 “박차를 가하라”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee: "The Military Academy has staged 3 coups; we must integrate quickly" (李 “육사 쿠데타 3번, 빨리 통합해야”)
item.description:
Lee: "The Military Academy has staged 3 coups; we must integrate quickly" (李 “육사 쿠데타 3번, 빨리 통합해야”)

President Lee Jae-myung said at a defense ministry briefing held at the Blue House on the 5th, "The Korea Military Academy has been at the center of no fewer than three military coups in the Republic of Korea, yet it has never been held accountable. Could it not happen again? We must structurally make it impossible in the future." (이재명 대통령이 5일 청와대에서 열린 국방부 업무보고에서 “대한민국에서 군사 쿠데타를 무려 세 번이나 한 중심이 육군사관학교인데, 한 번도 책임을 묻지 않았다. 앞으로 또 할 수 있지 않느냐”며 “앞으로 구조적으로 절대로 못 하게 해야 할 것”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the government's push to integrate the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies, President Lee said, "All of South Korea's military coups occurred within the Army—they were the work of Army Academy graduates. Integration will reduce the likelihood of this happening," adding the remarks in that context. (이 대통령은 정부가 추진 중인 육·해·공군 사관학교 통합과 관련해 “대한민국 군사 쿠데타는 다 육군에서 벌어진 일, 육사 출신들이 한 일”이라며 “통합을 하면 이럴 가능성이 줄어든다”면서 이같이 말했다.)

President Lee stated, "The Republic of Korea has become an advanced nation that the whole world looks to, yet who would have thought that Army generals would collude in a military self-coup? This is not something to simply brush aside as a past event that was suppressed." The remarks are interpreted as signaling intent to hold the Military Academy accountable and integrate it, given that Army Academy graduates were involved in the December 3 martial law declaration, following the May 16, December 12, and May 17 incidents. President Lee also instructed Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek to "pursue the integration swiftly and forcefully—do it fast." <<> The Korea Military Academy Alumni Association, which opposes the integration, said the same day, "The true intention behind the consolidation of the military academies has been revealed. The Military Academy has produced countless officers who have devoted themselves to national security. We express deep regret and serious concern over the President's remarks." <<> Regarding the recent controversy over troops at the Army's 1st Corps and elsewhere not loading live ammunition during guard duty, so-called "empty rifle" patrols, President Lee said on the same day, "With an annual defense budget of nearly 66 trillion won, it makes no sense to say, 'Surely a war won't break out—why waste the money?' If we let military discipline slide one step at a time, we could end up in a situation where there isn't a single arrow left in the arsenal." <<> Meanwhile, at the justice ministry briefing, President Lee, responding to Justice Minister Chung Sung-ho's report that the passage of the amended Criminal Procedure Act had created problems for the operation of joint prosecution-police investigation teams, said, "I haven't read the amended Criminal Procedure Act, but does it say prosecutors are not allowed to investigate?" (이 대통령은 “대한민국이 전 세계가 바라보는 선진국이 됐는데 육군 장성들이 동조해 군사 친위 쿠데타를 할 걸 누가 생각이나 했겠나”라며 “이미 지난 일이고 진압이 됐다고 그냥 적당히 넘어갈 일은 아니다”라고 했다. 5·16, 12·12, 5·17에 이어 12·3 비상계엄에도 육사 출신이 연루됐으니, 책임을 물어 육사를 통합하겠다는 취지로 해석된다. 이 대통령은 안규백 국방부 장관에게 “신속하고 강력하게, 빨리 (통합을 추진)하라”고도 했다.)

item.title: "South Korea rises as pivotal nation amid U.S.-China hegemony competition... AI should be the center pillar of the alliance" (“한국, 미·중 패권 경쟁 속 중추 국가 부상… AI를 동맹 중심으로 삼아야”)
item.description:
"South Korea rises as pivotal nation amid U.S.-China hegemony competition... AI should be the center pillar of the alliance" (“한국, 미·중 패권 경쟁 속 중추 국가 부상… AI를 동맹 중심으로 삼아야”)

Kim Sung-han, honorary professor at Korea University's Graduate School of International Studies and former deputy national security adviser, said South Korea is emerging as an indispensable pivotal nation amid the AI era, leveraging its strengths in semiconductors such as high-bandwidth memory (HBM), advanced manufacturing, and digital infrastructure. He proposed that in the U.S.-South Korea bilateral relationship, AI should become not merely a technological issue but the "center pillar" of alliance strategy. In a recent article contributed to the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS), a foreign policy and security think tank in Washington, D.C., Kim argued that the "moment of AI" has arrived for the U.S.-South Korea alliance. (전(前) 정부 국가안보실장을 지낸 김성한 고려대 국제대학원 명예교수는 한국이 인공지능(AI) 시대를 맞아 고대역폭메모리(HBM) 같은 반도체, 첨단 제조, 디지털 인프라 분야 강점을 바탕으로 없어서는 안 될 중추적인 국가로 부상하고 있다며 한미 양자(兩者) 관계에 있어서도 AI가 단순한 기술 문제가 아닌 동맹 전략의 ‘중심 기둥(center pillar)’이 돼야 한다고 제안했다. 김 교수는 최근 워싱턴 DC의 외교·안보 싱크탱크인 전략국제문제연구소(CSIS)에 기고한 글에서 한미 동맹에 ‘AI의 순간(moment)’이 도래했다며 이같이 주장했다.)

Kim said, "The essence of the AI competition lies not in developing better models per se, but in the ability to convert technology into national capability," and added that based on South Korea's strengths across multiple fields, it "is emerging as a pivotal nation that can connect U.S. innovation to the actual field." He continued that South Korea's role will become increasingly important in areas such as data centers, batteries, nuclear energy, robotics, and the defense industry, and argued that the U.S.-South Korea alliance should evolve beyond a traditional military and security alliance into a broad technology alliance encompassing AI, semiconductors, energy, and other advanced technologies. (김 교수는 “AI 경쟁의 본질은 더 나은 모델을 개발하는 일 그 자체에 있는 게 아니라 기술을 국가적 역량으로 전환하는 능력에 있다”며 한국이 여러 분야에서 갖고 있는 강점을 바탕으로 “미국의 혁신을 실제 현장으로 연결할 수 있는 중추적인 국가로 부상하고 있다”고 했다. 이어 데이터 센터, 배터리, 원자력, 로봇 공학, 방위 산업 등 다양한 분야에서 한국의 역할이 점점 더 중요해질 것이라며 한미 동맹이 전통적인 군사·안보 동맹을 넘어 AI, 반도체, 에너지와 기타 첨단 기술을 아우르는 광범위한 기술 동맹으로 발전해야 한다고 했다.)

With the United States and China competing for hegemony in the AI era, Kim said that through U.S.-South Korea cooperation, "the United States can reaffirm its global leadership in sustaining the liberal international order in the AI era." Noting that AI discourse in the United States focuses on artificial general intelligence (AGI) and that despite being the top innovation powerhouse, its manufacturing base has been significantly reduced, he said, "The United States is leading the AI revolution, but it cannot win alone." He added, "Converting AI into economic and military power requires a strong manufacturing base and resilient supply chains," and assessed that South Korea can become an essential partner in the AI ecosystem that compensates for America's structural weaknesses. (AI 시대 패권을 놓고 미국과 중국이 경쟁을 벌이고 있는 가운데, 김 교수는 한미 협력을 통해 “미국이 AI 시대에 자유주의 국제 질서를 유지하는 데 있어 글로벌 리더십을 재확인할 수 있을 것”이라고 했다. 그는 미국 내 AI 관련 담론이 범용 인공지능(AGI)에 초점을 맞추고 있고, 최고의 혁신 강국임에도 불구하고 제조업 기반이 상당 부분 축소됐다는 한계를 언급하며 “미국이 AI 혁명을 주도하고 있지만 미국 혼자서는 승리할 수 없다”고 했다. 이어 “AI를 경제·군사력으로 전환하기 위해서는 강력한 제조 기반, 탄력적인 공급망이 필요하다”며 한국이 미국의 구조적 약점을 보완하는 AI 생태계의 필수적인 파트너가 될 수 있다고 봤다.)

Kim said, "South Korea is an indispensable nation that can connect innovation and AI diffusion," and "Washington (the United States) should regard AI not as a mere technological issue but as the core of alliance strategy." He also proposed that the two countries establish a joint industrial agenda encompassing semiconductors, cloud, robotics, and shipbuilding. He further argued that through a "AI, Energy, and Semiconductor Dialogue" co-chaired by the White House National Security Council (NSC) and the South Korean presidential office, they should address issues such as resolving infrastructure bottlenecks, coordinating AI investments, and protecting supply chains. Kim also said, "Unlike authoritarian states that focus on surveillance and control, the United States and South Korea should lead a model that seamlessly combines AI technological innovation with open markets, democratic accountability, and trustworthy infrastructure," adding, "The two countries should take the lead in establishing democratic AI standards." (김 교수는 “한국은 혁신과 AI 확산을 연결할 수 있는 없어서는 안 될 국가”라며 “워싱턴(미국)은 AI를 단순한 기술 문제가 아닌 동맹 전략의 핵심으로 간주해야 한다”고 했다. 이어 한미가 반도체, 클라우드, 로봇 공학, 조선 분야 등을 아우르는 공동의 산업 의제를 수립할 것을 제안했다. 또 백악관 국가안보회의(NSC)와 대통령실이 공동 의장을 맡는 ‘AI·에너지·반도체 대화’를 통해 인프라 병목 현상 해소, AI 투자 조정, 공급망 보호 같은 문제를 다뤄야 한다고 주장했다. 김 교수는 “권위주의 국가가 감시, 통제에 중점을 두는 것과 달리 한미는 AI 기술 혁신을 개방된 시장, 민주적 책임성, 신뢰할 수 있는 인프라와 매끄럽게 결합하는 모델을 선도해야 한다”며 “한미가 민주적인 AI 표준 수립에 앞장서야 한다”고도 했다.)

item.title: Stock Market and Real Estate in Turmoil, but People Power Party's Policy Command Post Vacant for Two Months (증시·부동산 난리인데, 국힘은 정책사령탑 두 달째 공석)
item.description:
Stock Market and Real Estate in Turmoil, but People Power Party's Policy Command Post Vacant for Two Months (증시·부동산 난리인데, 국힘은 정책사령탑 두 달째 공석)

The People Power Party's (PPP) policy committee chairmanship has remained vacant for two months. Policy issues such as the aftermath of real estate tax reform and stock market instability are pouring in, but the party has failed to fill the position that oversees its overall policy direction. Inside and outside the party, there is talk that "the selection of the policy committee chair has been effectively postponed indefinitely due to disagreements between co-leaders Representative Jang Dong-hyuk and Floor Leader Chung Choun-sook." (국민의힘 정책위의장 공석(空席) 사태가 두 달째 이어지고 있다. 부동산 세제 개편 후폭풍, 증시 불안 등 정책 이슈가 쏟아지고 있지만 당의 정책을 총괄하는 자리를 채우지 못하는 것이다. 당 안팎에선 “투톱인 장동혁 대표와 정점식 원내대표의 이견(異見)으로 정책위의장 인선이 사실상 무기한 연기됐다”는 얘기가 나온다.)

The appointment of a successor to the PPP's policy committee chair has been delayed for more than 60 days since June 5, when then-Policy Committee Chair Chung Choun-sook resigned to run for floor leader. The PPP had stated its plan to appoint the policy committee chair after forming standing committees, but no discussions on the selection have reportedly taken place as of the 5th. (국민의힘 정책위의장 후임자 인선은 지난 6월 5일 당시 정점식 정책위의장이 원내대표 출마를 위해 사퇴한 후 60일 넘게 미뤄지고 있다. 국민의힘은 상임위원회 구성 이후 정책위의장을 임명한다는 방침이었지만, 5일까지도 인선 논의가 이뤄지지 않고 있는 것으로 전해졌다.)

Floor Leader Chung is known to have had in mind two-term lawmaker Park Soo-young (Busan Nam), a former administrative exam passer, for the position of policy committee chair. The two are alumni of Seoul National University's law school. However, Representative Jang reportedly expressed reluctance. Another figure favored by Jang's side is said to be unacceptable to Floor Leader Chung. (정 원내대표는 정책위의장으로 행정고시 출신인 재선 박수영(부산 남) 의원을 염두에 뒀던 것으로 알려졌다. 두 사람은 서울대 법대 동문이다. 하지만 장 대표가 난색을 표시한 것으로 전해졌다. 장 대표 측이 낙점한 또 다른 인사는 정 원내대표가 받아들이지 않는 분위기다.)

According to the PPP's party constitution, the party leader appoints the policy committee chair, but stipulates that "the appointment must be confirmed by a general meeting of lawmakers in consultation with the floor leader." In the past, the system operated as a running-mate system where lawmakers elected the floor leader and policy committee chair candidate together, but the system was abolished in 2021. A PPP official said, "The authority to appoint the policy committee chair lies with the party leader, but the floor leader is responsible for bringing the appointment proposal to the general meeting of lawmakers," adding, "The vacancy in the policy committee chairmanship should be seen as a power struggle between the two top figures, Jang Dong-hyuk and Chung Choun-sook." (국민의힘 당헌에 따르면 정책위의장은 당대표가 임명하지만 “원내대표와의 협의로 의원총회의 추인을 받아야 한다”고 규정하고 있다. 과거에는 의원들이 원내대표와 정책위의장 후보를 함께 뽑는 러닝메이트제로 운영됐지만 2021년 제도가 폐지됐다. 국민의힘 당직자는 “정책위의장 임명권자는 당 대표지만 임명안(案)을 의원총회에 올리는 책임자는 원내대표”라면서 “정책위의장 공석 사태는 장동혁·정점식 투 톱의 주도권 다툼으로 봐야 한다”고 했다.)

As a member of the party leadership, the policy committee chair attends Supreme Council meetings and can voice opinions when discussing sensitive internal party matters such as disciplinary actions. For this reason, the PPP has repeatedly seen the policy committee chair position filled by lawmakers close to the leadership rather than policy experts. A lawmaker from the Yeongnam region said, "Now is the time to stake the party's fate on resolving tax, stock market, and real estate issues that threaten people's livelihoods," adding, "We should select someone with outstanding policy capabilities and break the practice of 'taking care of one's inner circle.'" (정책위의장은 당 지도부 일원으로 최고위원 회의에 참석한다. 징계 등 민감한 당내 현안을 논의할 때 의견을 개진할 수 있다. 이 때문에 국민의힘에서는 정책통보다는 지도부와 가까운 의원이 정책위의장을 맡는 관행이 되풀이되고 있다. 한 영남권 의원은 “지금은 민생을 위협하는 세금, 증시, 부동산 문제 해결에 당의 명운을 걸어야 할 때”라면서 “이제라도 정책 역량이 뛰어난 인사를 발탁해서 ‘측근 챙기기’라는 관행도 끊어내야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Ahead of the Honam primary... Song Young-gil and Kim Min-seok revive "Impeach Cho Hee-dae" (호남 경선 앞두고… “조희대 탄핵” 다시 꺼낸 송영길·김민석)
item.description:
Ahead of the Honam primary... Song Young-gil and Kim Min-seok revive "Impeach Cho Hee-dae" (호남 경선 앞두고… “조희대 탄핵” 다시 꺼낸 송영길·김민석)

As Song Young-gil, a candidate in the Democratic Party of Korea's leadership race, said on the 5th that he would "pursue the impeachment of Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae," Kim Min-seok immediately responded, "I agree." At the TV debate held that day among party leader candidates, the two also sparred over who had been more aggressive in pushing for the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers. The ruling camp interpreted the exchange as "a competition for distinctiveness ahead of the Honam primary on the 15th, where one-third of voting party members are based." <<> During the TV debate that day, Song asked Jeong Cheong-rae, a candidate who had previously served as party leader, "Why haven't you attempted to impeach Chief Justice Cho until now?" Jeong responded, "Because we couldn't trust the Cho Hee-dae Supreme Court, we set up an insurrection trial division and introduced the crime of distorting the law." When Kim asked, "The government requested in May the abolition of supplementary investigation powers that the party had demanded—why did you oppose it?" Jeong shot back, "The whole world knows who pushed prosecution reform more forcefully. Why didn't you call me to push the bill through?" <<> Stock market volatility also came under fire. Jeong said, "Many people are shedding tears of blood over the single-stock leveraged ETF (exchange-traded fund) that was handled carelessly when Kim Min-seok was prime minister." In response, Song said, "Didn't Jeong, who was party leader at the time, hold party-government consultations on the leveraged ETF?" adding, "How little trust must there have been between the party and government for such consultations not to take place?" <<> The candidates also revisited suspicions of Shincheonji's involvement in the party convention. Jeong said to Kim, "You're trying to fabricate a nonexistent 'anti-Lee Jae-myung' faction and raising baseless suspicions about Shincheonji's interference in the party convention—these are malicious claims that dragged the convention into the mud." Kim responded, "I raised all the Shincheonji issues—is that such a capital crime?" and, referring to Jeong's move to refer him to the party's ethics committee, said, "It's like accusing the person who cried fire of being the arsonist." Song said, "Once the joint investigation unit's findings come out, let's look into it together." (더불어민주당 당대표 선거에 출마한 송영길 후보가 5일 “조희대 대법원장 탄핵을 추진하겠다”고 하자 김민석 후보가 즉각 “공감한다”고 했다. 이날 열린 당대표 후보 TV 토론회에서도 누가 검찰 보완수사권 폐지 등에 더 적극적이었는지를 두고 논쟁을 벌였다. 여권에선 “권리당원 3분의 1이 있는 15일 호남 경선을 앞두고 선명성 경쟁에 벌인 것”이라는 해석이 나왔다.)

item.title: 'Kim Yong-beom' Talk Surges in the Blue House... "Must Take Responsibility for the KOSPI Crash" (요즘 여권서 ‘김용범’ 얘기 늘었다… “코스피 급변 사태 책임져야”)
item.description:
'Kim Yong-beom' Talk Surges in the Blue House... "Must Take Responsibility for the KOSPI Crash" (요즘 여권서 ‘김용범’ 얘기 늘었다… “코스피 급변 사태 책임져야”)

Calls for accountability are mounting against Kim Yong-beom, the Blue House chief of staff for policy, over the introduction of single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs), which have been blamed for the sharp market volatility—not only from the opposition but also from within the ruling bloc, including the Democratic Party and the Rebuilding Korea Party. As international media raise concerns about the Korean stock market and many fund investors suffer losses, worsening public sentiment, voices inside the Blue House are emerging saying "It's time for Director Kim to take responsibility." However, President Lee Jae-myung, two days after returning from his South America tour, had made no notable comment on the issue as of the 5th. <<> Cho Kuk, former leader of the Rebuilding Korea Party, wrote on Facebook that day: "The current crisis is a failure of government-directed finance created by the core of the administration's policy, led by Director Kim Yong-beom." He added, "Since the ruling Democratic Party is silent, I will speak clearly from the position of a 'red team' (those playing the role of a hypothetical adversary within an organization). Accountability must be placed on Director Kim, along with Yoon Chang-ryeol, chief of staff at the Office for Government Policy Coordination; Lee Eok-won, chairman of the Financial Services Commission; and Lee Chan-jin, governor of the Financial Supervisory Service." (급격한 주가 변동 원인으로 지목된 ‘단일 종목 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF)’ 도입을 놓고 야당은 물론 더불어민주당과 조국혁신당 등 범여권에서도 김용범 청와대 정책실장 책임론이 제기되고 있다. 한국 증시에 대한 해외 언론의 우려가 커지고 펀드 투자자 상당수가 손해를 봐 민심이 악화하자 청와대 일각에서도 “김 실장이 책임져야 할 때”라는 말이 나오고 있다. 하지만 이재명 대통령은 남미 순방에서 돌아온 지 이틀이 지난 5일에도 이 문제에 대해 별다른 언급을 하지 않았다.)

The Democratic Party officially draws a line against the opposition's calls for a parliamentary inspection, saying "resolving the situation comes first." Internally, however, strong discontent is detectable toward the policy line of the Blue House and the government, including Director Kim. The ruling party maintains that "there was no party-government consultation, nor proper notification, when the leveraged ETF was introduced." (조국 전 조국혁신당 대표는 이날 페이스북 글에서 “작금의 사태는 김용범 실장을 필두로 한 정부의 정책 핵심이 만들어낸 관치 금융의 실패”라고 했다. 이어 “집권 민주당이 침묵하고 있기에 ‘레드팀(한 조직 내에서 가상의 적 역할을 하는 사람)’ 입장에서 분명히 말한다”며 “김 실장을 비롯해 윤창렬 국무조정실장, 이억원 금융위원장, 이찬진 금융감독원장에게 각각의 책임을 물어야 한다”고 했다.)

In particular, among ruling party lawmakers on the National Assembly's Political Affairs Committee, there is talk that Director Kim's resignation is necessary to soothe investors exhausted by repeated market surges and plunges. Multiple Democratic Party committee members, speaking on condition of anonymity, told this paper by phone: "Isn't it public opinion that the person responsible for this situation should resign?" and "This is a situation where due accountability must be taken." (민주당은 공식적으로는 “사태 수습이 우선”이라며 야권의 국회 국정조사 요구 등에 선을 긋고 있다. 그러나 내부적으로는 김 실장을 비롯한 청와대와 정부 정책 라인에 대해 강한 불만이 감지되고 있다. 여당은 “레버리지 ETF 도입 당시 당·정 협의가 없었던 데다 통보도 제대로 받지 못했다”는 입장이다.)

Calls for Director Kim's responsibility have also begun to surface within the Blue House itself. During a briefing in Brazil on the 28th of last month while accompanying the president on his tour, Kim said, "The high volatility in our (stock) market is intertwined with the characteristic of individual investors investing dynamically." At the time, the People Power Party pushed back, calling it "an ignorant remark shifting blame for the market decline onto individuals." It has been reported that Blue House aides who remained in the country raised concerns that "a policy chief blaming the public could backfire." (특히 국회 정무위원회 소속 여당 의원들 사이에서 주가 급등락 반복에 지친 투자자들을 달래기 위해 김 실장 사퇴가 필요하다는 이야기가 나오고 있다. 익명을 요구한 복수의 민주당 정무위원은 본지 통화에서 “이 사태에 대한 책임자가 사퇴해야 한다는 게 국민 여론 아니냐”며 “마땅한 책임을 져야 할 상황”이라고 했다.)

Still, the prevailing view is that the likelihood of President Lee replacing Director Kim is low. A Blue House official said, "As far as I know, there is no discussion at all about Kim's status," adding, "Now is the time to devise measures and respond actively to both the stock market and real estate, not to assign blame." Another official noted, "If Kim steps down, it would look like the Blue House is admitting it was the main actor in this situation." (청와대 내부에서도 김 실장 책임론이 불거지기 시작했다. 대통령 순방에 동행한 김 실장은 지난달 28일 브라질에서 가진 브리핑에서 “우리나라 (주식 시장) 변동성이 큰 것은 개인 투자자들이 역동적으로 투자하는 시장 특성과 맞물려 있다”고 했었다. 당시 국민의힘은 “주가 하락의 책임론을 개인에게 돌리는 몰상식한 발언”이라고 반발했는데, 국내에 남아 있던 청와대 참모들은 김 실장 발언에 “정책 책임자가 국민 탓을 했다가 역풍이 일 수 있다”는 우려를 제기했던 것으로 전해졌다.)

Within the Blue House and the government, there is also considerable opinion that criticism over this controversy is being excessively heaped on Director Kim. A ruling bloc source said, "At the time of introducing the single-stock leveraged ETF, the situation was contradictory because leveraged products on domestic stocks were only traded in foreign markets," adding, "The decision was made by gathering opinions from various figures inside and outside the government, so turning it into one man's responsibility is 'scapegoating.'" (하지만 이 대통령이 김 실장을 교체할 가능성은 낮다는 관측이 우세하다. 청와대 관계자는 “김 실장 거취에 대한 논의는 전혀 없는 것으로 안다”며 “지금은 증시도 부동산도 대책을 세우고 적극 대응할 시점이지 잘잘못을 따질 때가 아니다”라고 했다. 다른 관계자는 “김 실장이 물러나면 청와대가 이번 사태의 주체라는 걸 인정하는 모양새가 된다”고 했다.)

Regarding Financial Supervisory Service Governor Lee Chan-jin's remarks in June that "I regret not having blocked (the leveraged ETF introduction) even by lying down," there is also talk within the Blue House calling it "a belated attempt to dodge responsibility." Jung Jeom-sik, floor leader of the People Power Party, repeatedly requested a parliamentary inspection on that day, saying, "This is not about political strife but about conducting a review to restore the damaged trust in the market," and added, "Shouldn't we bring key figures like Director Kim Yong-beom, Deputy Prime Minister for the Economy Koo Yun-cheol, and Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eok-won together and question why the single-stock leveraged ETF was introduced so hastily and recklessly?" (청와대와 정부 내에선 이번 논란에 대한 비판이 김 실장에게 과도하게 쏠리고 있다는 의견도 적지 않다. 여권 관계자는 “단일 종목 레버리지 ETF 도입 당시 국내 주식에 대한 레버리지 상품이 외국 시장에서만 거래되는 모순된 상황이었다”며 “여러 정부 안팎의 의견을 모아 도입을 결정한 것인데 김 실장 한 사람 책임으로 몰아가는 건 ‘희생양 만들기’”라고 했다.)

Director Kim held a lunch that day with Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon to discuss real estate issues, including measures for housing supply in Seoul. According to attendees, Mayor Oh said, "Through redevelopment and reconstruction projects, we can supply a net increase of 85,000 housing units by 2031," and "There is no solution if we neglect redevelopment and reconstruction. Please convey this to the president." Oh also expressed that "easing the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport guidelines on mandatory ratios of industrial facilities in semi-industrial zones would further boost housing supply," and Kim reportedly nodded, asking, "That was an MOLIT guideline?" Previously, Kim had said "Just build, no questions asked," citing semi-industrial zones in Seoul's Yeongdeungpo and Guro as candidate sites for housing supply. (이찬진 금감원장이 지난 6월 “(레버리지 ETF 도입을) 드러누워서라도 막았어야 했나 후회한다”고 언급한 데 대해서도 청와대 내에선 “뒤늦은 책임 회피 발언”이란 말도 나온다. 정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 이날 여당에 국정조사를 거듭 요청하며 “정쟁이 아니라 훼손된 시장의 신뢰를 회복하기 위해 점검을 하자는 것”이라며 “단일 종목 레버리지 ETF를 왜 이렇게 성급하고 무리하게 도입한 것인지 김용범 실장, 구윤철 경제부총리, 이억원 금융위원장 등 주요 책임자를 한자리에 모아놓고 따져야 하지 않겠느냐”라고 했다.)

item.title: Lee: "I haven't read the revised Criminal Procedure Act... Does it say prosecutors can't investigate?" (李 “개정 형소법 안 읽었는데… 검사가 수사하면 안된다고 돼 있나”)
item.description:
Lee: "I haven't read the revised Criminal Procedure Act... Does it say prosecutors can't investigate?" (李 “개정 형소법 안 읽었는데… 검사가 수사하면 안된다고 돼 있나”)

President Lee Jae-myung, while receiving work reports from the Ministry of Justice and the Ministry of the Interior and Safety on the 5th, asked about the revised Criminal Procedure Act, which completely abolishes prosecutors' direct investigative authority: "I haven't read the revised Criminal Procedure Act, so I'm not sure, but does it say under the revised law that prosecutors must not investigate?" (이재명 대통령은 5일 법무부와 행정안전부의 업무 보고를 받으면서 검찰의 직접 수사권을 전면 폐지한 형사소송법(형소법) 개정안에 대해 “저는 개정된 형소법을 안 읽어봐서 그런데, 개정된 형소법에 의하면 검사는 수사하면 안 된다고 되어 있느냐”라고 물었다.)

Although the revision to the Criminal Procedure Act drew concerns from the legal community and civil society, and a poll showed 61% of the public opposed it, the Democratic Party of Korea pushed it through the National Assembly on the 31st of last month, and it was passed at a Cabinet meeting presided over by President Lee at the presidential office on the 4th. At the Cabinet meeting, President Lee said prosecutors had "effectively perpetrated dictatorship" by abusing investigative powers, and that abolishing those powers was "justice prevailing in the end." Yet just a day later, the President said he "hadn't read" the revision and asked about the core issue—whether prosecutors can investigate. The People Power Party said, "After shaking a criminal justice system that has stood for 72 years, the President brazenly says he 'hadn't read it'—this is the height of irresponsibility." <<> The President's remarks that day came during discussions on how to operate the joint prosecution-police investigation headquarters (Joint Investigation Headquarters, or JIH) going forward. Minister of Justice Jeong Seong-ho, regarding the nine JIH units currently in operation—including those for drug crimes and financial securities/virtual assets—said, "(Due to the legal revision,) the legal basis for operating the JIH is extremely fragile," adding, "In my view, there is no legal provision for it." In other words, if prosecutors, who can no longer conduct investigations, participate in the JIH, it would constitute an unlawful act. <<> When President Lee said, "If it's not prohibited, it can be done," Minister Jeong replied, "That's not the case," noting that if prosecutors without investigative authority participate in investigations, it could create problems with the admissibility of evidence and the maintenance of prosecution. In response, the President said he hadn't read the revision and asked whether the legal provision states that prosecutors must not investigate. Minister Jeong answered, "All legal basis for any investigation has been eliminated." <<> When President Lee asked again whether prosecutors' investigations had been "prohibited," Vice Minister of Justice Lee Jin-soo responded, "(The revision) is designed so that prosecutors do not exercise investigative authority at all. If prosecutors intervene directly in investigations, it could raise controversy over unlawful investigations, so we judge that the current JIH system cannot be maintained as is." This implies that all JIH units currently in operation would effectively have to be disbanded. <<> After the Ministry of Justice took the position that the existing JIH units were unlawful, Minister of the Interior and Safety Yoon Ho-jung said, "In the future, wouldn't a public prosecution-police JIH (Public Prosecution Service, Supreme Prosecutors' Office, and police) be created?" adding, "It's just that (prosecutors in the Public Prosecution Service) have no direct investigative authority, but they can offer opinions on investigations." The gist was that an organization similar to the JIH is possible. However, Minister Jeong firmly stated on the participation of Public Prosecution Service prosecutors, "There is no legal basis for joint investigations." President Lee asked, "So what will happen to the fate of the JIH?" and said, "We need to think about this in advance" before the law takes effect on October 2. <<> Regarding President Lee's remark that he "hadn't read the revision," a presidential office official said, "The content of the revision was revised multiple times during the National Assembly deliberation process. It seems to mean he knows the key points but hasn't read every fine detail." There were also suggestions that the President deliberately pretended not to know. A ruling party official said, "The President spoke as if he didn't know, while strongly urging minimizing side effects." But a figure from the legal community said, "The President is also a lawyer by background, so he knows better than anyone how dangerous and full of holes this revision is. He appears to have pretended not to know to offload responsibility for the passage of the revision." <<> The opposition party said the exchange between the President and the ministers that day was "appalling." Rep. Park Hyung-soo, the People Power Party's secretary on the National Assembly Legislation and Judiciary Committee, said, "It's absurd and baffling to see them only now discussing matters that should have been addressed before railroading the law through. Didn't the President hear the desperate cries of crime victims who pleaded that the law should not be revised?" Park Choong-kwon, the People Power Party's senior spokesperson, said, "The President presided over a Cabinet meeting without even knowing the content of the Criminal Procedure Act revision. This is reckless governance where improvisation trumps the law." Professor Cha Jin-ah of Korea University said, "Public Prosecution Service prosecutors have no investigative authority, so how can they offer advice on investigations? This system can never last." (형소법 개정안은 법조계와 시민사회계가 우려를 쏟아내고 국민의 61%가 반대한다는 여론조사 결과도 나왔지만, 지난달 31일 더불어민주당이 국회에서 강행 처리했고 지난 4일 이 대통령이 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 통과됐다. 이 대통령은 국무회의에서 검찰이 수사권을 남용해 “사실상 독재를 해왔다”면서 수사권 폐지는 “사필귀정”이라 말했다. 그런데 하루 만에 이 대통령이 개정안을 ‘안 읽어봤다’면서 핵심 사안인 검사의 수사 가능 여부에 관해 물은 것이다. 국민의힘은 “72년 동안 유지된 형사 사법 시스템을 흔들어 놓고 대통령이 당당하게 ‘안 읽어봤다’고 말하는 건 무책임의 극치”라고 했다.)

item.title: Blue House senior aide: "More important to address policy measures than to dismiss Kim Yong-beom" (靑 홍보수석 “김용범 경질보다 대책 챙기는 게 중요”)
item.description:
Blue House senior aide: "More important to address policy measures than to dismiss Kim Yong-beom" (靑 홍보수석 “김용범 경질보다 대책 챙기는 게 중요”)

Cheong Wa Dae senior communications secretary Sung Ki-hong said on the 6th, amid the growing calls for the dismissal of Policy Planning Chief Kim Yong-beom following the introduction of single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs), "At this point, it is more important to carefully monitor the market and work on countermeasures." This drew a line under the speculation about Kim's dismissal. (성기홍 청와대 홍보소통수석은 6일 단일 종목 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF) 도입 이후 불거진 ‘김용범 정책실장 경질론’에 “지금은 시장을 일단 유의 깊게 살피면서 대책을 챙기는 게 더 중요하다”고 밝혔다. 김 실장 경질론에 선을 그은 것이다.)

Appearing on CBS Radio that day, Sung said, "Not only is the volatility (in both the stock market and real estate) high, but the impact on people's livelihoods is also very significant." He added, "In that regard, not only Chief Kim but all Cheong Wa Dae officials are meticulously reviewing all of these matters, and we are very carefully examining what the causes are and how to prepare countermeasures." Sung also stated, "I would like to note that the government is sensitively monitoring stock market trends and responding responsibly." (성 수석은 이날 CBS 라디오에 출연해 “모두(증시와 부동산) 휘발성이 클 뿐 아니라 민생에 미치는 영향도 매우 크다”며 “그런 점에서 김 실장은 물론이고 청와대 당국자 모두가 이 모든 사항을 꼼꼼하게 점검하고 있고, 현재 원인이 무엇이고 대책을 어떻게 마련할 것인가 굉장히 세심하게 살펴보고 있다”고 했다. 성 수석은 “정부도 주식 시장 동향을 예민하게 살펴보면서 책임감 있게 대응하고 있다는 점을 말씀드린다”고 덧붙였다.)

Regarding the government's real estate policies, including the tax reform proposal, he said, "The goal of this real estate tax reform is to rationalize the real estate tax system," adding, "As President Lee Jae-myung has repeatedly stated, the government has no intention of trying to bring down housing prices through taxes." Sung said, "We are currently exploring multifaceted measures, including expanding housing supply and rationalizing housing finance," and added, "We plan to present policies to the public, including the supply issue, as soon as possible." (정부의 세제 개편안을 비롯한 부동산 정책에 대해서는 “이번 부동산 세제 개편의 목표는 부동산 세제를 합리화하는 것”이라며 “이재명 대통령도 누차 밝혔다시피 정부는 세금으로 집값을 잡겠다는 생각은 갖고 있지 않다”고 했다. 성 수석은 “주택 공급 확대와 주택 금융 합리화 등에 대한 다각적 대책을 현재 강구 중”이라며 “가급적 빠른 시일 내에 국민들께 공급 문제까지 포함해 정책을 내놓을 예정”이라고 했다.)

On the timing of the policy announcement, Sung said, "The timing has not been finalized yet, but we will announce it as soon as possible, without unnecessary delay." Regarding concerns that the tax reform plan would add pressure to the jeonse (lump-sum deposit) and monthly rental markets, he said, "We are listening to media reports, criticisms, and the voices of the people," and added, "There are concerns that tax burdens could be passed on to rents in the short term, reducing available jeonse and monthly rental listings, but institutional safeguards for tenant protection are already in place." (정책 발표 시점에 대해 성 수석은 “시기는 아직 확정되지 않았지만 가급적 늦지 않은 시간 내, 빠른 시일 내 발표하도록 하겠다”고 했다. 세제 개편안으로 전·월세 시장에 부담이 가중된다는 지적에는 “언론의 보도나 지적, 또 국민의 목소리에 귀를 기울이고 있다”며 “단기적으로 (세 부담이) 임대료로 전가되면서 전·월세 매물이 감소될 거라는 우려가 있는데, 세입자 보호를 위한 제도적 장치는 마련된 것들이 있다”고 했다.)

Sung said, "Going forward, the government will expand public rental housing supply for the stability of the jeonse and monthly rental markets and continue to promote measures to ease housing cost burdens for young people and those without homes." (성 수석은 “앞으로 정부는 전·월세 안정을 위해 공공 임대 공급을 확대하고 청년이나 무주택자에 대한 주거비 부담 완화 방안을 지속적으로 추진할 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: US Rethinking Nuclear Strategy Against China and Russia? "Discussion of New Strategy Emphasizing Short-Range Tactical Nukes" (美, 中·러 맞서 核전략 다시 짜나… “단거리 전술핵 강조 새 전략 논의”)
item.description:
US Rethinking Nuclear Strategy Against China and Russia? "Discussion of New Strategy Emphasizing Short-Range Tactical Nukes" (美, 中·러 맞서 核전략 다시 짜나… “단거리 전술핵 강조 새 전략 논의”)

The U.S. Department of Defense is developing a new nuclear weapons strategy to prepare for potential attacks by China and Russia, NBC reported on the 5th. Instead of long-range strategic nuclear weapons, which are extremely unlikely to actually be used in the event of a regional war, the aim is to reshape the nuclear strategy to place greater emphasis on short-range tactical nukes that can actually be launched against key targets. This move is being led by Elbridge Colby, the under secretary of defense for policy, who is the de facto architect of defense policy, and if actually adopted, it is expected to have a significant impact on the security landscape of Indo-Pacific allies such as South Korea and Japan. <<> Colby gave a closed-door speech that day at the "2026 Deterrence Symposium" held at U.S. Strategic Command (STRATCOM) in Omaha, Nebraska. STRATCOM is the key functional combatant command responsible for overseeing the U.S. nuclear force operations worldwide, strategic deterrence, and space and cyberspace defense. It also has the mission of providing "extended deterrence" (nuclear umbrella) capabilities to allies including South Korea. Citing sources, NBC reported that the new nuclear strategy proposed by Colby is designed to address scenarios in which U.S. allies come under attack by China or Russia in regional conflicts. A senior U.S. Department of Defense official told the press, "Our view is that we need credible nuclear options," explaining that this strategy would broaden the range of choices and contribute to strengthening deterrence. <<> Tactical nuclear weapons are weapons designed to achieve victory on the battlefield by striking limited, specific targets such as enemy front-line units or bases. In contrast, strategic nuclear weapons are differentiated as weapons that bring an end to war itself or devastate nations through their massive destructive power. Colby has long supported tactical nukes equipped with small, short-range warheads that target specific small-scale targets on the battlefield rather than entire cities such as capitals. This is because while long-range strategic weapons can destroy an adversary's nuclear forces, they are not seen as actually usable, which undermines allied confidence in the U.S. extended deterrent. A representative example is the recurring question raised domestically amid the growing North Korean nuclear and missile threat whenever arguments for nuclear armament emerge: "Would the U.S. really sacrifice Los Angeles (LA) for Seoul?" U.S. Forces Korea operated tactical nuclear weapons from 1958 to 1991, and they were fully withdrawn in accordance with the "Joint Declaration on the Denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula." <<> A U.S. Department of Defense official said, "If you want extended deterrence to be credible, you need to provide the political leadership of that country with nuclear forces that are sensible enough to be actually used." However, there are also criticisms that placing greater emphasis on tactical nukes could lower the threshold for nuclear use, increasing the risk of nuclear weapons being employed in conventional conflicts, and that in scenarios requiring the deployment of long-range nuclear weapons, it could lead the U.S. president to make different choices, thereby further weakening readiness. Colby faced considerable friction with Congress last year while drafting new documents such as the National Defense Strategy (NDS), with one senior congressional figure saying, "It's a study that is very far removed from President Trump's stated position of making nuclear deterrence great again." (미 국방부가 중국과 러시아의 잠재적 공격에 대비하기 위한 새로운 핵무기 전략을 수립하고 있다고 NBC가 5일 보도했다. 지역 전쟁 발발 시 실제로 사용할 가능성이 극도로 낮은 장거리 전략 핵무기 대신, 실제로 주요 표적을 향해 발사할 수 있는 단거리 전술핵에 더 큰 비중을 두는 방향으로 핵전략을 다시 짜려 한다는 것이다. 이런 움직임은 국방 정책의 실질적 입안자인 엘브리지 콜비 정책 담당 차관이 주도하고 있는데, 실제로 채택될 경우 인도·태평양 지역 동맹인 한국과 일본의 안보 지형에도 상당한 영향이 있을 것으로 보인다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Lee Claims He Hasn't Read Criminal Procedure Act... Is He Really the President? I Wonder What's Going On in His Mind" (장동혁 “형소법 안 읽었다는 李... 대통령 맞나, 정신세계가 궁금”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk: "Lee Claims He Hasn't Read Criminal Procedure Act... Is He Really the President? I Wonder What's Going On in His Mind" (장동혁 “형소법 안 읽었다는 李... 대통령 맞나, 정신세계가 궁금” )

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk on the 6th, referring to President Lee Jae-myung's remarks the previous day that he "hasn't read the revised Criminal Procedure Act," said, "Is he really our president? Should we even acknowledge him as president?" (국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 6일 전날 “개정된 형사소송법을 안 읽어봤다”고 언급한 이재명 대통령을 향해 “우리나라 대통령 맞느냐. 우리가 대통령으로 인정해야 되느냐”고 했다.)

At a Supreme Council meeting held that morning at the National Assembly, Jang said, "The president is spewing unprecedented reckless remarks, but he does so so calmly and nonchalantly that the public can hardly even recognize them as reckless." (장 대표는 이날 오전 국회에서 최고위원회의를 열고 “대통령이 역대급 망언을 쏟아내고 있는데 너무 태연하게 아무렇지도 않게 망언을 쏟아내고 있어서 국민들은 이게 망언인지조차 느끼기 어려울 정도”라며 이같이 말했다.)

He continued, "The entire nation has been in an uproar over this revision to the Criminal Procedure Act that abolishes supplementary investigative powers. Over 60% of the public still opposes it. The victim of the Busan 'spin-kick' case even created a new X account and posted a heartfelt plea to the president saying, 'You must not abolish supplementary investigative powers'—and this is how the president responded." (그는 “보완수사권을 폐지하는 이 형사소송법 개정안 때문에 대한민국 전체가 떠들썩했다”며 “60% 넘는 국민이 아직도 반대하고 있다. 부산 돌려차기 피해자가 X(엑스) 계정을 새로 만들어서 대통령에게 ‘보완수사권을 폐지하면 안 된다’고 절절한 글을 올렸는데 대통령이 이렇게 발언한 것”이라고 했다.)

He added, "I'm curious about President Lee's current state of mind. What did he mean by saying that? I can't even begin to analyze it." Jang also said, "No matter how I think about it, this Criminal Procedure Act revision is something that simply cannot be allowed to exist. It's an irresponsible act of dodging responsibility by claiming he passed it without properly reviewing the legal text, fearing he'd be remembered as a sinner in history." (그러면서 “이 대통령의 지금 정신 세계가 궁금하다. 어떤 의미로 이 말을 했을까. 분석조차 잘 되지 않는다”고 했다. 장 대표는 “아무리 생각해봐도 도저히 있을 수 없는 형사소송법 개정안이기에 두고두고 역사에 죄인으로 남을까 봐 법조문을 잘 안 보고 통과시켰다고 책임을 회피하는 무책임한 모습”이라고 했다.)

Jang said, "A president who meticulously searches news articles down to every comma and period and demands posts be deleted from X, a president who even monitors party members' comments to engage in online spats with them over party affairs—this same president says he didn't look at the Criminal Procedure Act revision. So what, does that mean he has no interest in the people or the country? Is it 'I only care about myself,' 'I have no interest in anything but myself'? What is this?" (장 대표는 “언론 기사는 쉼표, 마침표까지 일일이 검색해서 X에 기사를 삭제하라고 살피는 대통령이, 당무 개입에 대해서는 당원의 댓글까지 일일이 살펴서 당원과 SNS에서 말싸움까지 하는 대통령이 형사소송법 개정안은 보지 않았다고 말한 것”이라며 “그렇다면 국민은, 나라는 관심 없고 ‘나는 나밖에 모른다’ ‘나는 나 외에는 관심이 없다’ 뭐 이것이냐”고 했다.)

He then said, "It's deplorable." Jang added, "Justice Minister Jung Sung-ho said the Criminal Procedure Act revision was pushed through at the speed of light. If the Lee Jae-myung regime and the Democratic Party revised the Criminal Procedure Act at the speed of light, and if the president didn't even bother to read a single provision of it, then ultimately the regime will collapse at the speed of light." (그러면서 “참담하다”고 했다. 장 대표는 “정성호 법무부 장관이 형사소송법 개정안에 대해 빛의 속도로 개정됐다고 했다”며 “이재명 정권이, 더불어민주당이 형사소송법을 빛의 속도로 개정했다면 그리고 대통령이 그 형사소송법 법조문을 읽어보지도 않았다면 결국 정권이 빛의 속도로 무너질 것”이라고 했다.)

Earlier, during a briefing from the Ministry of Justice and the Ministry of the Interior and Safety the previous day, President Lee Jae-myung asked about the Criminal Procedure Act revision that entirely abolishes prosecutors' direct investigative authority, saying, "I haven't read the revised Criminal Procedure Act, but does it say prosecutors must not conduct investigations under the revised law?" This sparked controversy, as it was interpreted that the president—just one day after passing the revision in a Cabinet meeting—claimed he "hadn't read" it and asked about the core issue of whether prosecutors can investigate. (앞서 이재명 대통령은 전날 법무부와 행정안전부의 업무 보고를 받으면서 검찰의 직접 수사권을 전면 폐지한 형사소송법 개정안에 대해 “저는 개정된 형소법을 안 읽어봐서 그런데, 개정된 형소법에 의하면 검사는 수사하면 안 된다고 되어 있느냐”라고 물었다. 이 대통령이 국무회의에서 해당 개정안을 통과시킨 지 하루 만에 개정안을 ‘안 읽어봤다’면서 핵심 사안인 검사의 수사 가능 여부에 관해 물은 것으로 해석되며 논란이 됐다.)

However, Cheong Wa Dae Senior Secretary for Public Relations and Communication Sung Ki-hong appeared on CBS radio that day to manage the fallout, saying, "The president is, of course, fully aware of the overall intent and core content of the Criminal Procedure Act revision. I understand those remarks came out in the process of him asking questions about the joint prosecution-police investigation headquarters." Sung explained, "Yesterday's remarks were made in the context of instructing that prosecutors and police prepare for all possible scenarios that could arise under the new legal framework, ensuring there is no inconvenience to the public's lives going forward." (다만 성기홍 청와대 홍보소통수석은 이날 CBS 라디오에 나와 “(이 대통령이 형소법 개정안에 대해) 전반적인 취지라든지 핵심 내용을 당연히 충분히 숙지하고 계시다”며 “검·경 합동수사본부의 내용을 묻고 질문하는 과정에서 그 발언들이 나온 걸로 이해한다”며 진화에 나섰다. 성 수석은 “새로운 법체계를 통해 형성될 수 있는 모든 가능한 경우에 검찰이나 경찰이 대비하라, 앞으로 과정에서 국민의 삶에 불편함이 없도록 준비해야 한다는 차원에서 어제 발언이 나온 것”이라고 밝혔다.)
